claims.value: Cohere Labs Aya Vision 8B is an open weights research release of an 8-billion parameter vision-language model. It is multilingual, trained to excel in 23 languages, and optimized for use cases including OCR, captioning, visual reasoning, summarization, and question answering.
claims.evidence: **Cohere Labs Aya Vision 8B** is an open weights research release of an 8-billion parameter model with advanced capabilities optimized for a variety of vision-language use cases
**Input:** Model accepts input text and images. **Output:** Model generates text.
optimized for a variety of vision-language use cases, including OCR, captioning, visual reasoning, summarization, question answering, code, and more.
